title: Triangulated product-preserving functors preserve homotopy limits
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ and $\mathcal D$ be pretriangulated categories [def-weil-triangulated-category] with integer shifts, zero objects, and countable products [def-weil-category-product]. Let $\Phi:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ be additive, equipped with a commutation with shifts and a triangulated-functor structure. If $\Phi$ preserves the countable product of every tower, then $\Phi$ sends every homotopy-limit (Roos/Milnor) cone of a tower in $\mathcal C$ to a homotopy-limit cone of the image tower in $\mathcal D$.
